name: DHL Supply Chain - Melrose Park DC - Melrose Park IL

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: DHL eCommerce sortation center at 2065 George Street, Melrose Park IL - 352,000 sq ft, LEED Silver, opened June 2023, houses a Honeywell IntelliSort cross-belt loop sorter (40,000 parcels/hr). Confirmed via Street View showing the DHL logo on the building face (2024-09 capture). One building in a dense suburban-Chicago industrial park.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard-booth checkpoint at the truck-apron entrance. A black ornamental/perimeter fence runs along the George Street frontage (green setback strip), but the truck apron itself opens directly to the access road with no controlled pinch-point. Flagged uncertain - the frontage fence indicates some security intent and a low-profile gate cannot be fully ruled out from imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure visible at the entrance or anywhere on the property in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single continuous dock-door bank along the SW face of the building; estimated ~35 doors, banded 25-50. Sortation centers typically have a heavy dock count for parcel throughput.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Rows of marked trailer stalls on the SW side of the apron (across from the dock face) hold ~20+ trailers - 10-25 band for trailers parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A dedicated trailer-storage area with marked rows runs along the SW edge of the shared apron.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron in front of the dock face provides internal holding/queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long shared apron and access road give room for 3+ trucks to queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Melrose Park is inside the dense Chicago metro industrial fabric - tightly packed large warehouses on all sides. Urban.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on a single building face only - no separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; a rail line runs through the wider district but does not enter the DHL parcel.

citations.claim: DHL opened a 352,000 sq ft LEED Silver DC at 2065 George Street, Melrose Park IL, with a Honeywell IntelliSort sorter (40,000 parcels/hr).
DHL opened the Melrose Park facility Aug 2023; one of three US international-export gateways, currently operating.

verification.rationale: DHL-operated at the exact address and currently operating; FLAG: division mismatch - operator is DHL eCommerce (parcel/e-commerce sortation), not DHL Supply Chain contract logistics.
